Monday, 20 March 2023
8750 Hits
Medical Superintendent Kasturba Hospital, Sevagram Wardha invites the following to appear for written examination at 11.00 AM on Dated 25/03/2023 at Examination Hall, MGIMS, Sewagram. The personal interview will be conducted on 27/03/2023 at 11.00 AM in the Medical Superintendent Office, Kasturba Hospital, Sewagram. Kindly note that no separate intimation will be given.
The candidates should bring along the original certificate in respect of their educational qualification, experience, age proof, cast validity (if applicable) for verification by the authorities if called for interview. In case failed to produce the above mentioned original certificates, the candidature will not be considered.
Please note that No TA & DA for attending the written test or interview will be given and the decision of Selection Committee will be final.
Appearing for the written examination does not give you any claim for appointment.
List of candidates selected for written exam
List of rejected candidates
In case of any doubt, please contact MS Office (Dispatch Section) by 24th March, 1 PM. No requests shall be entertained beyond the specified period.
Swachhata Pakhwada April 2024
